DOC-001.title: Aster Power Assemblies / NovaDrive Technologies program disclosure
DOC-001.detail: Aster Power Assemblies Ltd. has been named a production supplier to NovaDrive Technologies for component M10, used in P1, P3. Production takes place at SITE-018. The award is effective from 1 January 2025 through 31 December 2026. The disclosed contracted allocation is approximately 60% of NovaDrive requirements for this component; this is a planning allocation, not a purchase ledger or guarantee of realized deliveries.

DOC-002.title: Production qualification: Aster Power Assemblies to NovaDrive Technologies
DOC-002.detail: A separate production qualification register names Aster Power Assemblies Ltd., site SITE-018, as qualified for NovaDrive Technologies Ltd. in the M10 program. Registration confirms the approved relationship and site, but is not itself evidence of exclusive supply.

DOC-075.title: CommonSpan consolidation note
DOC-075.detail: CommonSpan Holdings Ltd. (ORG-268) consolidates Aster Power Assemblies Ltd. and Boreal Power Systems Ltd. as controlled subsidiaries. Separate brands do not imply separate ultimate ownership. This is an ownership statement, not a statement that CommonSpan manufactures or supplies components.

DOC-076.title: Jade corporate structure
DOC-076.detail: Jade Circuits Holdings Ltd. (ORG-445) is the accounting parent of Jade Printed Circuits Ltd. (ORG-453). The operating plant is SITE-081 in Z01; SITE-901 in Z07 is the registered headquarters and does not manufacture circuit substrates.

DOC-077.title: IonPeak capacity and qualification statement
DOC-077.detail: IonPeak Semiconductor Ltd. manufactures the NovaDrive-relevant production power dies at SITE-074 in East Delta (Z01). SITE-900 in Western Ridge is a research and pilot facility using a different process. It is not a qualified replacement for these dies. Ion Peak Trading Ltd., registry REG-NO-4128, is an unrelated broker, not a subsidiary of IonPeak Semiconductor.

DOC-078.title: Current power-die sourcing note
DOC-078.detail: The current M10/M20 programs at both Aster and Boreal use the same qualified IonPeak production die family from SITE-074. No second die source is currently qualified for these programs. A different module assembler therefore does not provide independent die supply. PolarSwitch is a prospective alternative only.

DOC-079.title: Current circuit-substrate sourcing note
DOC-079.detail: Cobalt C10 programs and Grove/HarborSense B10 programs currently use Jade substrates from SITE-081. The listed substrate is program-specific. There is no presently qualified independent substrate in the supplied corpus; this is not a claim about all of these companies' products.

DOC-080.title: Archived Delta supplier award
DOC-080.detail: Delta Capacitor Works supplied housings to NovaDrive under a pilot program in 2022. That housing program ended on 31 December 2023. The current capacitor award is separate. Do not treat the expired housing award as a current H10 supply connection.

DOC-083.title: Harbor Freight role clarification
DOC-083.detail: Harbor Freight Services acts as a consolidator or notify party on a number of shipping manifests. It does not manufacture the listed electronics. OceanLink Ports operates a terminal; neither name should automatically be classified as a component manufacturer.

DOC-084.title: Supplier launch correction
DOC-084.detail: A 2024 memorandum between Delta Consumer Plastics and NovaDrive concerned trial retail packaging, not production electronics. The trial did not convert to a supply award. Similarity of the word Delta does not connect this company to Delta Capacitor Works.

DOC-085.title: Solace program clarification
DOC-085.detail: Solace Optics has completed a sample evaluation with Grove Battery Controls. No serial-production award has been announced. The supplied evidence does not substantiate a current B10 production link. A team may retain this as a hypothesis, but should not assert a confirmed supply relationship.

DOC-086.title: Quartz raw-material sourcing note
DOC-086.detail: Quartz Alloy confirms integrated alloy processing but does not identify bauxite sources. Its membership of a minerals association is not a supplier declaration. Direct upstream sourcing remains unverified.
